coordinate_topology.derivation: Cell topology derived from the pinned hardik-1da047f coordinate/cell export; geometric admissibility separately checked against Chiodo's conditions.
coordinate_topology.edge_provenance: Every atomic edge in each pinned profile records one or more generating triangles, orientations, and base/leg roles.
coordinate_topology.vertex_provenance: Every vertex records incident parent sides and native apex/base-point/intersection/triple-concurrency types.
coordinate_topology.address_space: profile-scoped deterministic IDs; equal ordinals across profiles do not assert cross-profile identity

P_topology.maps: printed SYG numbered vertex/edge -> coordinate geometric entity
P_topology.required_bridge: SYG numbered vertex/edge <-> coordinate vertex/atomic edge <-> generating triangle/side
blockers: No coordinate key accompanies the supplied numbering.
The printed adjacency has 140 edges, but the coordinate-derived 69-vertex/74-bounded-face arrangement has 142.
The printed face-boundary pairs do not directly agree with its primal adjacency labels.
P_topology.allowed_use: motif hypothesis and comparison only; not canonical provenance

P_construction.available: Chiodo conditions and high-level two-fold/Apollonius construction claims
P_construction.not_available: complete point-by-point Chiodo construction DAG and authenticated Mahesh/Kulaichev derivational ledgers
P_construction.non_equivalence: P_construction does not establish P_topology and is not inferred from graph adjacency

mahesh_mapping.required: M1-M18 coordinates, triangle-triple incidence table, orientation convention, and construction order

firewall: P_topology and P_construction are stored separately.
Graph structure cannot substitute for non-structural geometric dependence.
Construction order cannot be promoted to intrinsic necessity without an independent proof.
